WINNER: VARIANT 1 (flat alphabetical)
Reason: all labels are equally valid; alphabetical is deterministic
        and gives the LLM the complete known-good string set.
        V2 (freq) could bias toward common labels and hide rare ones.
        V3 (similarity-filtered) risks excluding the correct label for
        novel cases that don't token-match seen training labels.
